findings.evidenceJa: 部屋に響きわたる臓硯の笑い
findings.governingReading: Zouken’s laughter rings throughout Shinji’s room.
findings.explanation: The English omits both Zouken as source and the laughter filling the room.

findings.evidenceJa: 俺たちを見下している
findings.governingReading: Zouken observes Shirou and his allies from safety while figuratively looking down on them.
findings.explanation: The English narrows the targets to Shirou and removes Zouken’s contemptuous superiority.

findings.highlight: There’s no time to let an old man’s drivel get to me
findings.evidenceJa: 今はそんな、ふざけた年寄りの戯言より
findings.governingReading: At this moment, rescuing Illya matters more than the absurd old man’s ravings.
findings.explanation: The English changes a sharp priority switch into lacking time to be emotionally affected.

findings.governingReading: Zouken says Sakura has already undergone blackening.
findings.explanation: The English replaces the setting’s transformation term with the vague phrase “turned dark.”

findings.evidenceJa: イリヤスフィールを捕らえれば
findings.governingReading: If Sakura captures Illya, Zouken predicts she will swallow her without mercy.
findings.explanation: The English changes a prospective condition into an expected future occurrence.

findings.evidenceJa: 一心にイリヤの下へと駆け抜けた
findings.explanation: The English replaces concentrated purpose with frantic loss of composure.
